QueryString.value: WITH runs AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, coalesce(Pipeline, '') AS Pipeline, toString(BuildId) AS BuildId, coalesce(Result, '') AS Result, coalesce(Role, '') AS Role, if(coalesce(PullRequestId, 0) > 0, toString(PullRequestId), '') AS PullRequestId, if(coalesce(ParentBuildId, 0) > 0, toString(ParentBuildId), '') AS ParentBuildId, coalesce(TargetBranch, '') AS TargetBranch, coalesce(Platform, '') AS Platform, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(Agents, '') AS Agents, toFloat64(coalesce(DurationSeconds, 0)) AS RunDuration, toFloat64(coalesce(QueueSeconds, 0)) AS QueueWait, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp(coalesce(Started, QueuedAt))) AS RunStarted, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp(coalesce(Finished, Started, QueuedAt))) AS RunFinished FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineRun FINAL ), steps AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(StepName, '') AS StepName, toString(BuildId) AS BuildId, RecordId, coalesce(ParentId, '') AS ParentId, coalesce(RecordType, '') AS RecordType, coalesce(Category, '') AS Category, coalesce(Agent, '') AS Agent, coalesce(Result, '') AS StepResult, toString(coalesce(Attempt, 0)) AS Attempt, coalesce(ErrorCode, '') AS ErrorCode, coalesce(ErrorMessage, '') AS ErrorMessage, toFloat64(coalesce(DurationSeconds, 0)) AS StepDuration, toFloat64(coalesce(Errors, 0)) AS Errors, toFloat64(coalesce(Warnings, 0)) AS Warnings, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp(Started)) AS StepStarted FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineStep FINAL WHERE Started IS NOT NULL ), runkeys AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, BuildId, if(ParentBuildId NOT IN ('', '0'), ParentBuildId, BuildId) AS TraceKey FROM runs ) SELECT r.Organization AS Organization, r.Project AS Project, r.Repository AS Repository, r.Pipeline AS Pipeline, r.BuildId AS BuildId, k.TraceKey AS traceID, concat('run-', r.BuildId) AS spanID, if(r.ParentBuildId NOT IN ('', '0'), concat('run-', r.ParentBuildId), '') AS parentSpanID, concat(r.Pipeline, ' #', r.BuildId) AS operationName, r.Result AS serviceName, toInt64(round(r.RunStarted * 1000)) AS startTime, toInt64(round(if(r.RunDuration > 0, r.RunDuration, greatest(r.RunFinished - r.RunStarted, 0)) * 1000)) AS duration, 'Run' AS Kind, r.Role AS Role, r.PullRequestId AS PullRequestId, r.TargetBranch AS TargetBranch, r.Platform AS Platform, r.Version AS Version, r.Agents AS Agent, '' AS Category, r.Result AS Result, '' AS Attempt, toInt64(0) AS Errors, toInt64(round(r.QueueWait)) AS QueueSeconds, '' AS ErrorCode, '' AS ErrorMessage, toInt64(0) AS Warnings FROM runs AS r INNER JOIN runkeys AS k ON k.Organization = r.Organization AND k.Project = r.Project AND k.BuildId = r.BuildId WHERE r.RunStarted > 0 UNION ALL SELECT s.Organization AS Organization, s.Project AS Project, r.Repository AS Repository, r.Pipeline AS Pipeline, s.BuildId AS BuildId, k.TraceKey AS traceID, s.RecordId AS spanID, if(s.ParentId != '' AND s.ParentId IN (SELECT RecordId FROM steps), s.ParentId, concat('run-', s.BuildId)) AS parentSpanID, s.StepName AS operationName, if(s.Category = '', 'other', s.Category) AS serviceName, toInt64(round(s.StepStarted * 1000)) AS startTime, toInt64(round(s.StepDuration * 1000)) AS duration, s.RecordType AS Kind, r.Role AS Role, r.PullRequestId AS PullRequestId, r.TargetBranch AS TargetBranch, r.Platform AS Platform, r.Version AS Version, s.Agent AS Agent, s.Category AS Category, s.StepResult AS Result, s.Attempt AS Attempt, toInt64(round(s.Errors)) AS Errors, toInt64(0) AS QueueSeconds, s.ErrorCode AS ErrorCode, s.ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage, toInt64(round(s.Warnings)) AS Warnings FROM steps AS s INNER JOIN runs AS r ON r.Organization = s.Organization AND r.Project = s.Project AND r.BuildId = s.BuildId INNER JOIN runkeys AS k ON k.Organization = s.Organization AND k.Project = s.Project AND k.BuildId = s.BuildId WHERE s.StepStarted > 0 AND s.RecordId != ''
